$comment: Dev runner config for scripts/dev/qd. Paths are relative to the repo root. Ports = <devDigit>0<portSlot>0 (Ali: devDigit 4 -> web 4010, admin 4020, api 4030). Per-machine overrides live in .qubo/dev.local.json (gitignored).

web.$comment: --hostname localhost (not {bind}): Next dev builds proxy URLs as localhost:<port>, and host-based rewrites only stay internal when the bind hostname matches. localhost resolves to 127.0.0.1, so it stays loopback-only.

dataPlane.localHint: Start Docker, then `supabase start` (or `docker start supabase_db_react`).
